'''Guardian Shard Cannons''' are fixed-mount, short-range weapons built from Guardian technology, firing a cluster of shards similar in spirit to a shotgun.

== Overview ==

Alongside the [[Guardian Gauss Cannon]] and [[Guardian Plasma Charger]], the Shard Cannon is one of the three weapons reverse-engineered from Guardian ruins. Its shard spread makes it hit hardest at close range and fall off quickly at distance, so builds using it typically favour aggressive, close-in engagement over long-range poking. See [[Guardian]] and [[Guardian Tech]] for the broader technology background.

As with the other Guardian weapons, unlocking the base weapon for purchase requires collecting Guardian materials and unlocking it through a Guardian Technology Broker, separately from the Engineering coverage below.
